summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting across login  ### What I found before proposing anything (read-only audit, no changes made) I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `modules/watchlist/schema.ts`, plus the auth layer (`db/auth.ts`, `modules/auth/handlers.ts`) and CORS/proxy config (`server.ts`, `vite.config.ts`).  Contrary to the ticket's own hypothesis, I did **not** find the suspected wiring bugs: - Watchlists and items are correctly scoped by `user_id` derived from the session cookie on every read/
